title: Slicing of currents with representations by Lipschitz functions: support and mass inequalities (Simon Ch. 6, 4.6–4.10)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), and suppose T and ∂T are represented by measures: there are Borel measures μ, μ' on ℝ^P, finite on compact subsets of U, and a.e. strongly measurable fields ξ (of (k+1)-vectors), ξ' (of k-vectors) with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ-a.e. x and |ξ'(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ'-a.e. x (Euclidean coefficient norm), T(ω) = ∫ξ(ω) dμ for ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(U) and ∂T(η) = ∫ξ'(η) dμ' for η ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be Lipschitz with constant L. Then there are currents A_t ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U), B_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t} ξ(ω) dμ and B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t} ξ'(η) dμ' (Simon's T⌞{f < t} and (∂T)⌞{f < t}), such that the slice Z_t := ∂A_t − B_t satisfies: (∂A_t)(η) = B_t(η), i.e. Z_t(η) = 0, whenever η ∈ 𝒟^k(U) and tsupport η is disjoint from {f = t}; for every open W and t, M_W(Z_t) ≤ L · liminf_{h→0⁺} h⁻¹ μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}); and for every open W and a, b ∈ ℝ, the lower integral ∫⁻_{(a,b)} M_W(Z_t) dt ≤ L · μ(W ∩ {a < f < b}).
